note: Phases describe the intended order of work and the conditions for moving on. They are planning categories, not delivery commitments, and carry no dates. A milestone is marked Completed only when there is evidence for it.

legendText.research: Open investigation, no commitment to build
legendText.conditional: Only happens if earlier results justify it

phases.title: Foundation & Product Definition
phases.summary: Brand, website, documentation, product research and the Ovia Protect requirements.
phases.gate: An approved PRD, including a validated way to discover approvals at zero additional cost.

milestones.title: Ovia Labs brand identity
milestones.evidence: Logo set and brand system in use across the website and this documentation.

milestones.title: Website repositioned for crypto security
milestones.evidence: New ovialabs.xyz built and tested locally. Not yet deployed.

milestones.title: Documentation platform and whitepaper v0.1
milestones.evidence: This site. Prepared for docs.ovialabs.xyz, not yet deployed.

milestones.title: Ovia Protect product requirements (PRD)
milestones.detail: Requirements are tracked as numbered work items.

milestones.title: PRD-010: approval discovery feasibility test
milestones.evidence: Validation report dated 17 November 2026. On-chain verification through a free public Ethereum RPC: GO. The free third-party approval API tested as a discovery source: NO-GO.

milestones.title: Select an approval discovery approach
milestones.detail: Evaluate further free sources and compare their results with on-chain state.

phases.title: Ovia Protect MVP Development
phases.summary: Architecture validation, implementation, internal testing and security review.
phases.gate: Scanner results reproduce on-chain allowance values at a recorded block, and known gaps are shown in the product.

milestones.title: Read-only ERC-20 approval scanner (Ethereum Mainnet)
milestones.detail: Public address input, no wallet connection, no signatures, no stored scans.

milestones.title: Internal testing against on-chain ground truth
Security review before any public release
milestones.detail: Scope and reviewer not yet decided.

phases.title: Protect Validation & Product Expansion
phases.summary: Testing with users, improving reliability, reviewing limitations and evaluating further functionality.
phases.gate: Evidence that people understand the results and that the data stays accurate under real use.

milestones.title: Permit2 and NFT operator approvals
milestones.detail: Evaluated after the ERC-20 scanner is proven.

milestones.title: Optional wallet connection
milestones.detail: Only if it adds clear value and passes a security review.

phases.title: Ovia Network Research
phases.summary: Exploring verification models, architecture, trust assumptions and feasibility.
phases.gate: A written feasibility assessment, published for review.

phases.title: Ecosystem Expansion & Token Feasibility
phases.summary: Evaluating whether broader network infrastructure and token mechanisms are technically, economically and legally justified.
phases.gate: A positive technical, economic and legal assessment. A negative outcome is an acceptable result.
